horizontal.escena:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE independent full-bleed narrative or symbolic PHYSICAL PAPER-CUT artwork, never a three-panel collage. All reference images are OUR OWN AI-generated visual-bible sheets. Use their identities, shapes and material language, not their multiple-view layouts, cropped auxiliary portraits or white specimen insets. Very expressive handcrafted thick matte dyed cardstock: clear pale cut cross-sections, lifted and curled edges, separated shadows between actual layers, deliberate hand-cut curves, folded leaf midribs, cut and folded feather vanes, visibly woven paper fibres, water as overlapping blue sheets and ripples. Heads and faces use few QUIET paper planes with natural proportions; no polygon-faceted CGI cheekbones, shiny skin, plastic dolls or digital-paint substitutes. Whole principal bodies, feet, wings, snouts, tails and ornament tips remain inside frame. The environmental world continues outside all four edges; no visible plinth, frame, diorama perimeter, tabletop, collage, model-sheet layout or printed text. Material depth comes between world layers. Colors differentiate each actor and each narrative rather than cloning the same hunter. Preserve proper reference clothes: bark/fibre covers and sparse seeds, feathers and small quill ornaments where present, no modern shirts, trousers, ponchos or synthetic beads. When a character has a pale nasal quill in the reference, make its near tip plainly visible at the nostril base against skin. No real-person likeness, private-photo reuse, medical or ritual instructions. This is original editorial art of the frozen adaptation, not a certified traditional motif.

MYTH: Nofïdeño, la Madre que sostiene la tierra. FORMAT: horizontal 16:9, preferably 1536 x 864. FUNCTION: ENTRADA: expansive environmental situation opening the myth; figures small within the world, not a giant portrait.
Reference 1: P04 — Nofïdeño — identidad y sostén. 
Reference 2: L02 — Chagra — claros, cultivos y recorridos. 
Reference 3: B01 — Yuca — planta, raíz y almidón. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
Wide Amazonian cultivated clearing at tender pink dawn. ONE whole Nofïdeño, the mature Mother from P04, sits calmly on low earth amid a young cassava garden; full loose cream fibre garment and existing ornaments. She lifts the edge of a thick curled EARTH PAPER LAYER with one hand, and living cassava shoots and little fruit trees arise along that gently lifted seam. Her body is ordinary human scale, small in an expansive garden, not a gigantic goddess or planet carrier. One impossible maternal relation: the land responds to her quiet care. No birth anatomy, infants, medicine or named extra humans. Warm ochre soil and folded green leaves make the earth look supported and tended.

VISIBLE CHECK: Madre completa, capa de tierra levantada y plantas naciendo en su borde.

Reference 1: P04 — Nofïdeño — identidad y sostén. 
Reference 2: L03 — Río · ribera baja y paso. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
Tall deep green forest at evening blue hour. ONE whole Mother matching P04 stands barefoot in a small opening, deliberately transferring a broad curved soil-and-root PAPER STRATUM from one shoulder toward the other. The living forest terrain is continuous with that curved stratum and occupies most of the world, as if the ground itself could rest against her shoulder; it is an editorial spatial visualization, not a literal mapped planet. Use no globe, continent map, city, extra goddess or giant cartoon person. A narrow vibration seam runs from the shifted earth into the forest ground. Full garment covers her body. Show the support and transfer clearly with two quiet arms and complete feet.

VISIBLE CHECK: Estrato vivo apoyado en el hombro, gesto de transferencia y suelo continuo.

MYTH: Nofïdeño, la Madre que sostiene la tierra. FORMAT: square 1:1, 1024 x 1024. FUNCTION: HUELLA: ONE primary motif plus ONE impossible symbolic operation, readable at thumbnail; not a third literal scene, parade of props or empty landscape.
Reference 1: B01 — Yuca — planta, raíz y almidón. 
Reference 2: L02 — Chagra — claros, cultivos y recorridos. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
Symbolic original editorial metaphor of maternal support. ONE large curled ochre EARTH-LEAF, shaped like a shallow cradle but still an uninterrupted piece of soil-colored paper, shelters a small living cassava plant inside its concavity. The curled rim casts a protective crescent shadow; the plant is rooted to its earthen carrier, not a cut flower in a bowl. Dew is small translucent cream-blue paper drops. No human, baby, animal, literal furniture, lettering or competing symbol. Dark blue-green surroundings continue full bleed; warm cradle and emerald cassava read at thumbnail size.

VISIBLE CHECK: Un solo pliegue de tierra protege una yuca en su concavidad.
